recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13795; detailed snapshot merge-rule documentation would require a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-13795 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I request to formally define a simple operation for generating a snapshot StructureDefinition from a differential StructureDefinition, without specifying complex dependency-resolution mechanics.
initial_application: Jira records application in svn revision 12818. That predates the current Git source history, but the first tracked new-build source commit already added OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-snapshot and the StructureDefinition operation-list entry.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread shows the informal $generate operation and the request to file #13795 for formal definition. FHIR-14411 later renamed the operation family to $snapshot and is already audited on the combined branch; FHIR-41351 later changed idempotence and affectsState wording while preserving the operation. FHIR-13402 was a broader snapshot-generation-rules request that ended Resolved - No Change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. StructureDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, its operation list references OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-snapshot, and the current OperationDefinition defines the snapshot operation with code snapshot, type and instance scope, definition/url inputs, and a StructureDefinition return value.

related_jiras.note: Renamed the same StructureDefinition snapshot-generation operation from $generate to $snapshot and is already represented on the combined branch.
Updated $snapshot idempotence and affectsState wording while preserving the operation definition and scope.
Asked for broader rules for generating snapshots but was ultimately Resolved - No Change, so it does not expand the operation-definition request.
